descriptionChirho: Hissing or whistling as an expression of scorn and derision, typically in prophetic judgment oracles. All clusters converge on the same meaning: Spanish 'silbido/burla' (hissing/mockery), Arabic 'صَفِيرٍ' (whistling/hissing), Hindi 'सीटी' (whistle), Korean '휘파람/비웃음' (whistling/ridicule), and Swahili 'mzaha/mzomeo' (jest/hissing). The two clusters differ only in grammatical framing—prepositional 'for a hissing' vs conjunctive 'and hissing'—not in lexical meaning.
